primary_comparison: v3 live deterministic policy versus disciplined ADP
positions: cycle seats 1 through 12; 67 rooms in seats 1-8 and 66 in seats 9-12
training: No fitted model, horizon probes, or parameter tuning on evaluation outcomes. Twelve-room pilot checked execution; its seeds are included in the 800-room total.
baseline_rules: All own-seat policies share positional caps; disciplined ADP fills legal starters, waits until the final two rounds for K/DEF, and avoids second QB/TE. Noisy ADP retains the historical opponent-style selection plus legal-starter completion. Legacy heuristic uses current data, not historical v2 saved-board outputs.
scope: Same fixed public forecast snapshot for drafting and projected lineup evaluation. Measures draft-policy gains under that forecast, not out-of-sample projection accuracy. No news or betting inputs in this snapshot. All results reported, including negative differences.
extra_test: 800 paired next-turn continuations at pick 20 using the fictional public example.
